name: run-shell-and-commit
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  run-and-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: read
    if: contains(github.event.issue.body, '@kimi-bot run')
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: mkdir -p "${{ github.event.issue.body }}"
      - run: |
          set -e
          scripts=$(find . -name "*.sh" -type f)
          for s in $scripts; do
            echo "Running $s"
            bash "$s"
          done
        env:
          OUTPUT_DIR: "${{ github.event.issue.body }}"
      - run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m "Automated: save generated files" && git push)
